payment._comment: Two official rails ONLY: Zelle to 305-244-0360, and the business's own Stripe Payment Link (URL filled by the operator from the Stripe dashboard; never a key, never a bank number). Until stripe_payment_link holds a real buy.stripe.com URL, the customer-facing text stays Zelle-only - drafts must never promise a link that does not exist. When the operator adds the link, update method and both text lines. Cash App, Venmo, PayPal, Square, and wire stay forbidden on every customer surface.

high_risk_dates._comment: Dates that fill first. Any inquiry landing on one carries schedule risk by default.

forbidden_claims._comment: Never generated by the tool. Insurance stays out until business/insurance-and-wave1-preflight.md records a verified active policy.
